description: Human-review queue for PNG legal material discovery and document verification. Queue entries are leads, not verified legal instruments.

candidates.title: PNG Constitution online text — edition and amendment verification
candidates.source_name: Ombudsman Commission of Papua New Guinea
candidates.reviewer_notes: Confirm edition, amendment coverage, certification/publication trail and later constitutional alterations against authoritative Gazette and parliamentary records. Page availability alone does not establish verification or current force.

candidates.title: Office of Legislative Counsel — source authority and publication pathway review
candidates.reviewer_notes: PMNEC describes OLC functions involving legislative advice, vetting, amendments, editing and printing. Confirm whether OLC provides a public document repository or formal verification contact. This is a source lead, not a legal instrument.

candidates.title: CLRC — reports and recommendations discovery
candidates.source_name: Constitutional and Law Reform Commission of Papua New Guinea
candidates.reviewer_notes: Separate final reports, draft bills, constitutional directives and recommendations. A recommendation is not enacted law unless enactment and commencement are independently established.

candidates.title: National Gazette archive — coverage, provenance and reuse review
candidates.reviewer_notes: For each instrument capture Gazette issue number, date and page, then compare with an official or certified copy. Confirm archive completeness, scan integrity and redistribution terms.

usage_notes: Discovery does not establish authenticity, legal effect, current legal status, or redistribution rights.
Review source identity and each resource before approval.
Verify legal status using appropriate evidence before recording a resource as in force.
Check redistribution permission before storing or distributing copies.
When permission is unknown, retain permitted metadata and source links instead of assuming copying is allowed.
Do not add personal, confidential, or completed case documents.
Keep rejected and duplicate records distinguishable from approved records.
Only approved candidates may be transferred to the legal-resources catalogue.
A source-authority review candidate is not itself legislation.
